annotation.method: individual source review; no product formatter or model prediction used
annotation.notes: 空值和子类型分派，连续多行条件块、完整多行构造调用。
annotation.comparison: shared output is the editable expected result

output_role: Human-reviewed expected output for dense input; predictions are written only to artifacts.
correction_policy: Source edits are allowed when dense and output are synchronized; compare the complete current output byte for byte.

evaluation_revision.input_policy: dense only; spaced removed at user request
evaluation_revision.note: 保留原始源码与期望布局，仅移除spaced输入。
